title: Adjust and retain an equipment enclosure compression latch
instruction: Adjust the unloaded grip-length knob, turn the wing handle clockwise to its locked position, then leave both hands off every enclosure part for 20 seconds.
setup: Fixed steel enclosure at root (0.28,0,0.7475)m, yaw -105deg, on standard Arena table. Exact 13 primitives, four passive joints, materials, initial poses, robot/station/camera/support dimensions are in setup-inventory.json. Both YAM bases (0,+/-0.305,0.9)m on fixed 240x120mm supports. Lid 300x400x4mm; 6.8mm gasket; adjustment knob radius15mm/height18mm; pawl24x20x6mm. No jitter.
scoring: Terminal continuous20s hands-off: handle>=175deg and pawl/flange clamp>20N throughout. Gap<1mm:1.0; gap<2mm:0.5; otherwise locked:0.25. Any missing/nonfinite measurement, cam stripped at any time, or80N wrist-force persistence0.1s:0. Cam draw torque>3Nm for0.1s strips cam permanently. Knob locks above2N pawl clamp and releases below0.5N.
reset_notes: Full reset clears mechanism and guard; source42 fixture fixed, object_jitter=0; Inspect-derived trial seeds accepted.
fidelity: CPU PhysX with source-bound seven-channel validation. Exact fixture geometry/mass/inertia and passive source thresholds retained; balanced finite-compliance cam and screw restraint approximate native equality. Contact friction/solver differs. Numerical armature is not mass. YAM has 27/7Nm total including gravity, left50N/right40N fingers. Actual Arena/YAM demo score1; Dream-1 not run. Historical runtime development records remain unchanged.
